Maple Street · after dark

PORCHLIGHT

The town fell at dusk. The last bus out leaves from the far end of the block. Houses with the porch light on still have supplies inside.

A D walk · J or Space fire (hold W / S to aim up / down) · E search a lit porch · Q swap gun · F swing bat · G grenade (or click and pull back) · R reload · P pause

Arrows to walk · hold FIRE · tap BAT to swing · SWAP changes guns · tap SEARCH at a lit porch
